WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.IsHoliday AS is_holiday, f.DateKey AS date_key, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_total
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
  GROUP BY d.IsHoliday, f.DateKey
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    avgIf(day_total, is_holiday = 'Yes') AS avg_holiday,
    avgIf(day_total, is_holiday = 'No') AS avg_regular
  FROM daily
)
SELECT
  avg_holiday,
  avg_regular,
  (avg_holiday - avg_regular) * 100.0 / nullif(avg_regular, 0) AS pct_difference
FROM agg
